test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error"**

Do not be put of by the/mathematical equation, because/this is really not very complicated.

options.text: Do not be put of by the
this is really not very complicated.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**Do not be put of by the**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct phrase is "**Do not be put off by the**"
 
• The error is in the use of "**put of**" instead of "**put off**"
 
• **Put Off**: This phrase means to postpone or delay something. It implies that you are rescheduling an event or task to a later time or date.
 
 
• **Example**: *She had to put off her vacation because of an unexpected work assignment.*
 
 
 
• The correct sentence should be "*Do not be put off by the mathematical equation, because this is really not very complicated*"

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
